prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Nitrogen (질소) itself — the sovereign of the Nitrogen Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a languid, sleepy-eyed ease; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — long monolid eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; low heavy brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; pale lilac eyes; a small beauty mark beside the lips.
Body and hair: slender build; an asymmetric bob, longer on one side with long bangs falling over one eye; frost-blue hair trailing a pale mist like liquid-nitrogen vapor.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Her element, carried in her design: nitrogen: 78 percent of the air, the quiet bulk of every breath that helps scatter the sky blue; violet and pink aurora curtains where it glows high above the poles; so calm it barely reacts, its two atoms locked by an unbreakable triple bond; pulled from the air it becomes bread and gunpowder alike — fertilizer and explosives; poured as liquid nitrogen at minus 196 degrees it breathes thick white mist; the backbone of every protein and every strand of DNA.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. a sleek frost-blue and pearl-white armored bodysuit of thin, long plates that follow her curves, three parallel lilac glow lines running along every edge like a triple bond, a fine DNA double-helix inlay spiralling up one forearm, white liquid-nitrogen vapor spilling from the joints, a slim back unit of two flat cryo canisters; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a sleek armored bodysuit — thin, long plates on the shoulders, arms and legs that follow her curves closely. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: frost blue, liquid-nitrogen mist white, aurora lilac-violet with a pink fringe, a touch of ripe-wheat gold.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, an atmosphere-harvesting biotech city: colossal white air-separation towers exhaling clouds of liquid-nitrogen vapor, a cryogenic gene vault where frozen DNA archives glow frost-blue behind glass, terraced vertical farms fed with nitrogen pulled from the sky.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (N) and atomic number (7) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
